personalization.introduce_yourself: I'm an HCI PhD student (Virginia Tech, on leave) working on tools for computing education: TutorTrace (UIST 2026) and the IDETrace dataset (NeurIPS D&B). Now co-founding a startup building a research notebook. I mostly use Perplexity for related work and quick facts. Prefer peer-reviewed sources (ACM DL, arXiv) over blogs. I also train for half marathons.
